messages:
kevin: Quick standup from me — posting a short GPU fleet snapshot for EMEA/NA before I head off.
kevin: EMEA spot buffer down to ~8% (target 15%). NA buffer healthy at ~22%. Seeing a small surge from sandbox tenants.
anya: Thanks — can you paste the dashboard link?
kevin: https://internal.redwood/metrics/gpu-capacity?range=3h — filters: region=eu-west-1,instance_type=A100
sam: Noted. I kicked off a small batch of prewarm jobs for EMEA (10 nodes) at 11:20 UTC. They show Pending due to quota error.
kevin: What error? Code/message?
sam: From cloud: 
```
ERROR: QuotaExceeded: You have requested more GPUs than your quota allows. RequestId: r-0a1b2c3d
```
sam: I've already started a support case (case #12345678) but wanted to flag here in case we need a manual mitigation.
vivian: @kevin @anya If quota takes >2h, we should trigger fallback routing to NA and spin up quantized q4 models to keep latency SLA. Do we have playbook for that?
kevin: Yup — playbook is in infra runbook (TL;DR): 1) update routing rule 'region-preference' to deprioritize eu-west-1, 2) increase batch-size cap on q4 model to reduce per-token GPU load. I'll do the routing change if quota doesn't clear by 12:15 UTC.
anya: I'm on the routing change if you need a hand. Also pinged cloud partner on the support case.
ops-sre: FYI observed one node in eu-west-1 with recurring OOM on shard 3 during long-context tests. Logs attached to linked alert. Might be related to new kernel.
kevin: Which AMI/kernel?
ops-sre: ami-0f9c1234, kernel v5.15. Running a quick repro now.
sam: Repro logs look noisy. Short-term mitigation: drain that node and reprovision. Command I ran: `kubectl drain gpu-wn-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
vivian: Please add a canary label once reprovisioned: `labels: gpu-canary=true` so we route a tiny % of traffic for 1 hour.
kevin: Will do. Also a quick heads-up: dedicated customer X will consume ~20% of NA capacity ~tomorrow 09:00 UTC for load test - stacked on top of usual traffic. Planning to reserve 12 A100s now.
anya: I'll open a reserved capacity ticket and allocate 12 units to that tenant for the window.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished for runtime v2.4.3 — 3/3 canaries passed :white_check_mark:
sam: Blockers: quota support case, one flaky kernel node. Otherwise morning ops good.
kevin: Today I'm going to: 1) if quota not fixed, flip routing (15m op), 2) drain+reprovision OOM node, 3) allocate reserved capacity for customer X. If anyone wants to pair on routing flip, ping me.
anya: I can pair at 12:00 UTC.
vivian: I'll monitor canary after reprovisioning and check perf SLOs.
kevin: ok thanks all — will post updates here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Auto-note: ticket #12345678 updated by sam at 1767555520
kevin: Update 12:10 UTC — cloud support bumped eu-west GPU soft quota by +14 while we wait for formal approval. Buffer recovering to ~16%.
kevin: Closing this thread unless new issues pop up.
